description: This file implements an integration of Noma Security Guardrail with LiteLLM, providing content moderation and safety checks for both user inputs and LLM responses. It includes classes for managing API interactions with Noma, handling guardrail logic such as content anonymization, blocking, and monitoring, along with hooks for pre-call, during call, and post-call processing.

classes.name: NomaBlockedMessage
classes.description: Custom exception raised when the Noma guardrail blocks a message due to policy violations.

classes.name: NomaGuardrail
classes.description: Main class implementing the interface with Noma Security's API for content moderation, including methods for request/response checking, anonymization, and background handling.
